name: Mousou Nikki: Joshikousei Hen
original_name: 妄想にっき 女子高生編
source:
Main character is torn apart between demon kid and angel kid. Demon summons erotic delusions where it's possible to do any perversions, and angel dissolves these illusions.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公夹在恶魔孩子与天使孩子之间。恶魔会召唤能够实现一切变态行为的色情妄想，而天使会溶解这些幻象。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndreview[/url]]
